svg.text: A chain down the page: spider silk's properties lead into its natural uses and glandular types, then into how
spiders spin it, then into humanity's struggle to copy that spinning, ending in real-world applications — a funnel

g.text: The article moves in one long chain: what silk is, what makes it work, how spiders use and produce it, how humans try
to copy it, and where that copy ends up being used.
